purpose: Prepared evidence map for display-brightness and keyboard-lighting diagnosis; it is not an executable collector.

probe_groups.expected: zero or more kernel backlight providers with bounded numeric/control metadata
probe_groups.notes: Absence, duplication, provider type, requested/actual mismatch, and power state are separate findings. Never write during diagnosis.

probe_groups.expected: zero or more kernel LED-class keyboard-light providers
probe_groups.notes: Do not treat unrelated status, radio, lock, or chassis LEDs as keyboard lighting.

probe_groups.expected: UPower exposure agrees with the underlying LED provider when supported
probe_groups.notes: SetBrightness is deliberately excluded from diagnosis.

probe_groups.expected: integrated/discrete adapters and internal-panel routing are distinguished
probe_groups.notes: Muxed and muxless systems behave differently. Avoid probes known to wake a runtime-suspended GPU unless separately justified.

probe_groups.expected: observed GPU runtime state is timestamped and correlated with provider presence
probe_groups.notes: Reading state is not permission to change power control, bind drivers, switch a mux, or launch work on the GPU.

probe_groups.source: GNOME session, power profile, switcheroo-control, and UPower status
probe_groups.expected: desktop control availability can be compared with kernel providers
probe_groups.notes: Run session-scoped queries only in the user's session and never as root.

probe_groups.source: kernel command line, loaded-module metadata, package facts, and bounded current-boot logs
probe_groups.expected: versioned evidence identifies recent changes and relevant warnings
probe_groups.notes: Logs are untrusted and potentially sensitive; redact and cap them. Protected logs require separate approval.

probe_groups.source: user-observed keypress plus bounded input-event observation
probe_groups.expected: the failure layer is narrowed without changing configuration
probe_groups.notes: Never start a blocking event monitor automatically. Require explicit user participation and a timeout.

state_comparison.reason: Changing GPU or power mode is state-changing and requires a separate exact plan and approval.
